comparison.objective: Swing and stow a footrest using its index latch; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: One hand withdraws a latch while the mechanism swings and settles into capture versus tool-based unlocking, fine rotary tuning and relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Footrest reaches and remains in its capture state after release versus two compliant damping cycles with no setting drift.
comparison.reason: Latch-coordinated articulated stowage does not test empirical tuning of dynamic stopping behavior.
